items.title: Case Dashboard Updates
items.note: Priority 3 -- firm is actively using the dashboard and asked for fixes, no deadline named, nothing blocked. Section 19 audit covered Justice Consumer Law groups on all four boards, subitems included (Ads: Meta Ads, Reports; Web + SEO: Website, GBP, Video for Website; Video: Youtube Video, 7 Ads; CRM: no JCL items) plus a keyword sweep for dashboard/Zoho/Netlify across every board: no reporting or dashboard item exists for this client, so create_item. Section 19b found no pending queue match. Sohib led the build on the call; Web + SEO's fixed owners are Hashir and Zayan, reassign on Monday if Sohib keeps it. Client side actions (Diana's stage audit, Andrew's Zoho fields and Rocco follow up) are noted as dependencies, not tasks. Two Fireflies recordings of the same 9/30 call were merged into this one card.

payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • On the 9/30 call Justice Consumer Law reviewed the case and settlement dashboard on Netlify, which pulls Zoho and Windsor data every two hours. They asked for the changes below.
  • Reconcile paid and unpaid counts. Zoho shows 82 paid and 13 unpaid cases, the dashboard shows 42 paid and 25 unpaid. Fix the year filter (case creation year vs payment year) and check the result against Zoho with Diana.
  • Rework Fees Collected in 2026 so it counts every payment received in 2026, including cases packaged in 2025 or earlier, not only the 278 cases packaged in 2026. Label it clearly.
  • Add pre suit and filed dates to the dashboard once the new Zoho custom fields exist.
  • Make each case clickable through to its Zoho record so the firm can verify and correct data directly.
  • Depends on the firm: Diana is auditing case stages (settled paid / unpaid) in Zoho and still enters payments monthly from Amy's accountant reports, so payment figures will lag until then. Andrew is only exploring payment import automation with Rocco, do not build it yet.

@Muhammad Hashir Faiz @Zayan Faiz

payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • Fibid is moving its Google Business Profile to the Regus office in Burr Ridge, Suite 210. Nate asked for status on 10/6. Hashir's 10/6 plan in the HVAC chat is the plan of record.
  • Do not change the address yet. The change sends the profile into reverification and we only want to go through that once. items.title: Deleted Appointment Messages
items.note: Priority 2: possible patient facing message on deleted appointments, flagged twice (10/5, 10/6). Ahmed said on 10/6 he would check; nothing on Monday tracks it. Section 19 audit: MedStation groups on all four boards, subitems included, plus a text sweep for deleted/appointment deletion/Eliana. Closest item is Neuryn Message Consolidation (Stuck), which is about Neuryn and GHL both messaging patients, not this trigger, so create_item. Section 19b: no pending queue match.

payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • On 10/5 and 10/6 MedStation staff posted screenshots in the GHL chat of a message showing on a patient's conversation after an appointment was deleted, and again on one that was not cancelled at all. On 10/6 they also flagged a GHL message carrying the name "Eliana". Their only concern is that patients must not receive these.
  • Confirm the channel of each flagged message. Mateus's read is that a bubble with no WhatsApp or SMS label is internal and never reached the patient; confirm or correct that in the chat.
  • Find the trigger: which workflow or NextGen sync event fires on appointment deletion or status change, and why it fired on an appointment that was not cancelled. Same for the "Eliana" message.
  • If anything patient facing fires on deletion, turn it off. If it is internal only, explain it in the chat so staff stop reading it as a patient message.
  • Do not touch Neuryn's own reminders; that overlap is Neuryn Message Consolidation.

@Ahmed Memon @Ali Shaheer

Only hits are Quality HVAC Missed Calls and Maadi Law Intake Call Drops, other clients, so create_item. Kept separate from Deleted Appointment Messages per the single item counter rule (call routing vs messaging). Section 19b: no pending queue match. Sohib has a call with MedStation and their IT on 10/7 at 10am, which is a good place to confirm which line this is.

payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • On 10/6 MedStation staff reported in the GHL chat that the phone rings only once before moving on, leaving no time to answer.
  • Identify the line and routing path behind it: GHL number, forwarding target, user device, voicemail handover. If the call does not route through GHL at all, say so in the chat.
  • Raise the ring timeout so staff can pick up. Quality HVAC went from 20 to 30 seconds on 9/25 for the same symptom; start there.
  • Test with a live call and confirm with staff in the chat.

@Ahmed Memon @Ali Shaheer
